hook.say: Europe's ten biggest cities, ranked by people inside the city limits. Paris is only number nine!

outro.say: Should Istanbul count as Europe? Comment below!

items.name: Vienna
items.say: Number ten: Vienna, the city of music. Two-point-oh-four million people.
items.cap: Number ten: Vienna, the city of music. 2.04 million people.

items.name: Paris
items.say: Nine: Paris! Only two-point-one million live inside the city limits.
items.cap: Nine: Paris! Only 2.1 million live inside the city limits.

items.name: Rome
items.say: Eight: Rome, the Eternal City. Two-point-seven-five million people.
items.cap: Eight: Rome, the Eternal City. 2.75 million people.

items.name: Kyiv
items.say: Seven: Keev, city of golden domes. Two-point-nine-five million people.
items.cap: Seven: Kyiv, city of golden domes. 2.95 million people.

items.name: Madrid
items.say: Six: Madrid, the biggest city in Spain. Three-point-five million people.
items.cap: Six: Madrid, the biggest city in Spain. 3.5 million people.

items.name: Berlin
items.say: Five: Berlin, eight times the area of Paris. Three-point-seven million people.
items.cap: Five: Berlin, eight times the area of Paris. 3.7 million people.

items.name: St. Petersburg
items.say: Four: Saint Petersburg, the world's northernmost big city. Five-point-six-five million people.
items.cap: Four: Saint Petersburg, the world's northernmost big city. 5.65 million people.

items.name: London
items.say: Three: London, where over 300 languages are spoken. Nine-point-one million people.
items.cap: Three: London, where over 300 languages are spoken. 9.1 million people.

items.name: Moscow
items.say: Two: Moscow, the biggest city entirely in Europe. Thirteen-point-three million people.
items.cap: Two: Moscow, the biggest city entirely in Europe. 13.3 million people.

items.name: İstanbul
items.say: And number one: Istanbul! Fifteen-point-seven-five million people, spread across two continents.
items.cap: And number one: İstanbul! 15.75 million people, spread across two continents.
